BOSSAURAS-EMPTY_AURA.title: Test Title
BOSSAURAS-KINSHIP.title: Kinship
BOSSAURAS-KINSHIP.description: In some combats, injured [gold]Kin Follower[/gold] will appear.
BOSSAURAS-TARRED.title: Tarred
BOSSAURAS-TARRED.description: At the beginning of combat, every creature gains [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Slippery[/gold].
BOSSAURAS-BOOMING_ECHO.title: Booming Echo
BOSSAURAS-BOOMING_ECHO.description: At the start of turn [blue]{Turn}[/blue], [gold]Stun[/gold] ALL enemies. At the start of the following turn gain [gold]Ringing[/gold].
BOSSAURAS-SLOW_SIPHON.title: Slow Siphon
BOSSAURAS-SLOW_SIPHON.description: At the beginning of turn [blue]{Turn}[/blue] every creature loses [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
BOSSAURAS-AGGRESSIVE_SIPHONING.title: Aggressive Siphoning
BOSSAURAS-AGGRESSIVE_SIPHONING.descripti:
Some combats are being siphoned by [gold]Lagavulin Matriarch[/gold].
At the start of the first three turns, ALL enemies lose [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
If the combat reaches turn [blue]{Turn}[/blue], [gold]Lagavulin Matriarch[/gold] gains [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
[gold]Strength[/gold] Siphoned: [blue]{SiphonCount}[/blue]
BOSSAURAS-LURE.title: Lure
BOSSAURAS-LURE.description: Begin each combat with [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Minor Beckon[/gold] in your discard pile.
BOSSAURAS-UNSTABLE_CORE.title: Unstable Core
BOSSAURAS-UNSTABLE_CORE.description: At the end of your turn [blue]{Turn}[/blue], deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL creatures.
BOSSAURAS-POWER_SURGE.title: Power Surge
BOSSAURAS-POWER_SURGE.description:
Whenever you play a [blue]Power[/blue] card increase the amount of [gold]Steam Eruption[/gold] the [gold]Waterfall Giant[/gold] starts with by [blue]{Increase}[/blue].
[gold]Steam Eruption[/gold] is currently increased by [blue]{ExtraSteam}[/blue].
